sql: SELECT "riskmanagement"."risktrace" AS k, (CAST("riskmanagement"."riskassess" AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."slapct") AS m1 FROM "riskmanagement" WHERE (CAST("riskmanagement"."riskassess" AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."slapct") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.risk score per SLA compliance rate
why: risk score / SLA compliance rate: the catalogue declares risk score part of SLA compliance rate
rank riskmanagement rows by risk score per SLA compliance rate

sql: SELECT "riskmanagement"."risktrace" AS k, ("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS m1 FROM "riskmanagement" WHERE ("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.control effectiveness score minus risk score
why: control effectiveness score - risk score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same risk management record
rank riskmanagement rows by control effectiveness score minus risk score
